theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {C : Type*} [AddCommGroup C] [Module k C] [Coalgebra k C] (E : Finset C), ∃ V : Submodule k C, FiniteDimensional k V ∧ (∀ x ∈ E, x ∈ V) ∧ ∀ x ∈ V, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k C C | ∃ a ∈ V, ∃ b : C, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b}
